title: How Netflix Uses Java - 2025 Edition
summary: A Netflix engineer describes how Netflix uses Java in 2025, including Spring Boot, DGS/GraphQL, gRPC and keeping over 3000 services on the latest JDK. It covers generational ZGC upgrade experiences.
why: Cited as a real-world enterprise Java example, especially for JDK upgrades and ZGC results.

quote.text: a talk from Netflix (hopefully sufficient enterprise for the discussion) that goes over how a JDK version upgrade to generational ZGC improved a bunch of their request timeouts
